0022600228.text: The Washington Wizards (4-8, 12th in the East) host the Detroit Pistons (7-3, 1st in the Central) in the Wizards' 13th game of the season, with Washington on a five-game losing streak and 2-6 on the road, while Detroit has won its last game and is 4-1 away from home. Washington is without Jamir Watkins (knee, surgery), Justin Champagnie (foot), Reece Beekman (shoulder) and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve), while Detroit is missing Isaiah Joe (hip bruise) and Jalen Duren (hamstring strain) and has Ugonna Onyenso listed as day-to-day with a foot injury and a game-time decision. Detroit beat Washington 122-111 in their last meeting in Detroit, leaving the Wizards trailing 0-1 in the 2026-27 season series after losing 1-3 to the Pistons in 2025-26.
